params.name: filters
params.description:
A delimited list of field filters.

Field name and value should be separated by a colon (:).

Multiple fields should be separated by a plus (+). Multiple fields are treated as an AND condition. Example, fieldname1:value+fieldname2:value

Multiple values for a field should be separated by a pipe (|). Mulitple values for a field are treated as an OR condition. Example, fieldname1:value1|value2

Filtering is not supported for the following fields: suspended

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The field name to order the results by.

params.name: orderByDirection
params.description: The direction to order the results by. ASC and DESC are valid values.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma separated list of fields to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the starting record. 0 indicates the first record.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum records to return. The maximum value allowed is 50.

params.name: modifiedStartDate
params.description: The modified on or after date.
